# Voice brief

For a human narrator or a synthetic voice. If any audio is synthetic, the `ASSETS.yaml` row and the disclosure go in the same PR as the video.

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| Voice type | Human / synthetic |
| Tool, model and voice id or preset (synthetic) | |
| Terms and licence for this use | |
| Language and accent | |
| Who the voice is | The project, as a calm, well-informed cabinet secretary. Never a real, named person. |
| Pace | About 150 words a minute as a starting point; replace with the measured rate after the first take. |
| Tone | Calm, direct, specific. No trailer voice. No swell on a fact. |
| Emphasis | On the new information at the end of the sentence. |
| Pauses | Before the decision. After the date. |
| What the voice must not do | Sell, sneer, grieve, or read a quote in a real person's voice. |
| Pronunciation list used | `pronunciation-list.md`, version and date |
| Native reviewer sign-off (Hebrew) | Name, date |
| Script hash and file sha256 | |
| Where the file is stored | In the repo, or "not in the repository" with the hash |
